Evidence: checkAll on a clean git-archive export of 6943a647 (the code tree of the landed merge; the merge adds only docs/plans from main): 4930 tests, 4927 passed, 0 failed, 0 errors, 0 ignored; 3 skipped by assume (the two worker/excerpt live courts, which have no venv or excerpt in a clean export, and one pre-existing pending test), 50 suite summaries, EXIT 0. media suites 40/40 (MediaProbeSuite 21, BoundarySearchSuite 13, F1ExcerptSuite 6), 0 ignored, live courts ran here against the local ffprobe/ffmpeg/worker and the local F1 excerpt. Mutation witnesses for this bead's guards, each killed by its named court with siblings green: PTS<DTS unchecked; tool identity dropped from receipt; undeclared stream ignored; input identity unchecked; missing PTS index invented; declaration ignores dropped frames; and from the review passes: sentinel accepted at parse; picture geometry unchecked; audio parameters unchecked; negative duration accepted; missingness read from sentinel; corrupt packet indexed; discard packet presented; unsupported stream indexed; duplicate stream index accepted. Three fresh-context cold reviews (scratchpad cold-review-a/b/c.md); pass-1 findings fixed in 3e1e2642, pass-2 in 6943a647.

Not established / follow-ups: every record is Draft (no E0 path); the join does not hash bytes (caller-verified identity; CI replays recorded envelopes); ToolRealization hashes the front-end binary only (dylib digests documented in ledger §6.2, not bound); stderr not receipted; F0 realizes holds not gaps, and missing PTS / corrupt or discard flags / gaps / negative durations / PTS<DTS are exercised on edited packet tables only; F0 byte reproducibility bound to Homebrew ffmpeg 7.1.1_3 (Lavf61.7.100 tags present); the nominated FFmpeg 9.0.1 LGPL-only recipe and OCI/SBOM closure stay RecipeOnly.
